boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase activities at Montclair State, with student-ID access noted where required.

cards.title: Bring a friend for pickup basketball
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Meet at the two-court gymnasium, bring a friend, and use the free student Recreation Center membership for a casual game.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair says current students receive free Recreation Center membership, and the center includes a two-court gymnasium.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation — Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Current students need a valid Montclair State University ID for free access.

cards.title: Play a racquetball round
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use one of the Recreation Center’s racquetball courts for an active one-on-one hang; confirm facility rules when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: An indoor court activity included with student access.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair lists two racquetball courts at its Student Recreation Center and states admission is free to students with a valid ID.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation — Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Current students need a valid Montclair State University ID for free access.

cards.entity_name: Student Recreation Center Elevated Indoor Track
cards.title: Take a lap-and-talk break
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Walk or run together on the elevated indoor track, then cool down before heading to your next class or study session.
cards.short_summary: A weather-proof movement break for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair lists an elevated indoor track at the Student Recreation Center and says student admission is free with valid ID.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation — Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Current students need a valid Montclair State University ID for free access.

cards.entity_name: Student Recreation Center Pool Open Swim
cards.title: Go for an open swim
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center Pool
cards.notes: Bring your valid ID, meet friends at the pool, and use general open swim without making a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Reservation-free pool time for eligible students.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair’s aquatics page says open swim requires no reservation and that current students receive a free Recreation Center membership.
cards.access_notes: Open swim requires a valid Montclair State University ID and compliance with Recreation Center regulations.

cards.title: Join a group exercise class
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Choose a listed in-person or virtual group exercise class and invite a classmate for a structured movement break together.
cards.short_summary: Free Campus Recreation classes for student-ID holders.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair’s Campus Recreation programming page states that Group Exercise offers free in-person and virtual group fitness classes.
cards.source_title: In Person & Virtual Programming — Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Recreation Center entry is limited to people swiping a Montclair State University ID.

cards.title: Settle in for console games
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use a Recreation Center lounge’s gaming consoles for a low-key group hang, and keep the space available for other students too.
cards.short_summary: Shared lounge gaming included with free student entry.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair lists multiple lounge areas with free Wi-Fi, TVs, and gaming consoles at the Student Recreation Center, where student admission is free with valid ID.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation — Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Current students need a valid Montclair State University ID for free access.

cards.title: Borrow gear and start a game
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Stop by Equipment Checkout with your Montclair ID, borrow available gear, and use it for a spontaneous activity with friends.
cards.short_summary: Free gear lending from Campus Recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair says Equipment Checkout lends a variety of equipment to students with a Montclair State University ID for free.
cards.access_notes: Equipment lending is for students presenting a Montclair State University ID; availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Do a workout side by side
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Plan a simple, self-directed workout in the dedicated fitness space and agree on a routine that works for everyone in your group.
cards.short_summary: A shared fitness session using student access.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair lists a 10,000-square-foot dedicated fitness space at the Student Recreation Center and says student admission is free with valid ID.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation — Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Current students need a valid Montclair State University ID for free access.

cards.title: Browse a gallery exhibition together
cards.subtitle: Red Hawk Parking Deck, fourth floor
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, visit during public hours, and use the free digital guide to compare reactions to the work.
cards.short_summary: Free public contemporary-art viewing on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair states that admission to University Galleries is free and open to the public; the George Segal Gallery is its flagship exhibition space.
cards.source_title: Visit — University Galleries, Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: The gallery is listed as closed until reopening in February 2026; verify current exhibition hours before visiting.

cards.title: Make an outdoor sculpture walk
cards.subtitle: Montclair State University campus
cards.notes: Pick several installed works, walk the campus route together, and pause to discuss what you notice before continuing to the next piece.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced public-art walk across campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair University Galleries states that it maintains public art installed throughout the campus, and gallery admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit — University Galleries, Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor works are on campus; follow posted campus access guidance and do not enter restricted areas.
